name: Invest in Aida
summary: Discover the epitome of luxury at Aida, Muscat, Oman, where sophisticated design meets breathtaking vistas 130m above the shoreline. Indulge in the exclusivity of our limited-edition 3-bedroom villas and 1 to 3-bedroom branded apartments, crafted in partnership with a renowned luxury hotel operator. Perched on the clifftops, each residence promises ultimate privacy, modern amenities, and direct access to lush landscapes and vibrant community hubs. Invest in Aida for a life of serenity and prestige on Oman’s pristine coast, with only a few units remaining.

name: Trump Furnished Residences
summary: Indulge in luxury living at the Trump Furnished Residences in Aida. Each residence is curated to exceed the highest standards of comfort and style. From stunning interiors to breathtaking views, every detail, down to the last sugar spoon has been thoughtfully designed to elevate your lifestyle.

name: La Collina
summary:
La Collina surpasses the typical mixed-use development, true to its name, it’s an elevated vision of urban living in Jeddah. Rising above the bustling cityscape of Jeddah, La Collina combines the beauty of elevated terrain with the innovation of modern urban planning.
Covering approximately 863,000 sqm, La Collina offers unparalleled investment opportunities through its residential, commercial and recreational spaces. Here, tradition and progress harmonize to shape a vibrant community on higher grounds.

name: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
summary: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.
featuring: The highest pool in the world
amenities: Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world

name: The Mulliner
location: 149 Old Park Lane, London, United Kingdom
summary:
Originally known as Gloucestor House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.
Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.
amenities: Daikin AC, underfloor heating, Loxone building management system, and MVHR system
Bespoke Oak Kitchen with premium Gaggenau, Bertazonni, Miele, and Caple Appliances
Bathrooms with Gessi Sanitaryware, Italian Marble Vanity Tops, and Bespoke Vanity Units
Floor Finishes with Polished marble, traditional oak parquet, European oak herringbone timber, and luxurious wool carpets
Wall Finishes with Vinyl and hand-woven wallpapers, gold leaf detailing, and polished plaster
Security  that has on-site 24-hour security, SSAIB-approved alarm, CCTV, and a 2N door entry system

name: Amour Sans Detour
summary:
Situated in AIDA, a renowned golfing destination and exclusive gated community perched 130 meters above Muscat Bay, these villas embody idyllic coastal vibes. Just steps from the sea and mere moments from the golf course, each villa is thoughtfully designed for ultimate relaxation and epic play.
Own a villa among the most spectacular stretch of turf and sand – a holiday home to enjoy forever, or to offer as an exclusive vacation home rental.

name: Trump Tower Jeddah
summary: Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. Apartments and penthouses range from 70 to 365 sqm across one- to four-bedroom configurations, all with uninterrupted Red Sea views. The tower includes the Trump Private Club, offering residents fine dining, a gym, pool, cigar lounge, and 24/7 concierge.

name: The Great Escape
summary: The Great Escape is a vibrant residential complex within AIDA, one the most beautiful gated community and golfing destinations in the world. Surrounded by the majestic hilltops, cliffs, and valleys of Muscat, The Great Escape literally rises out of the cliff edges, steps away from the ocean.

name: The Great Escape 2
summary: After the immense success of The Great Escape 1 and due to popular demand, a new luxury experience arrives next door. Within the vibrant Great Escape residential complex, is now The Great Escape 2, rising nine stories high at the edge of the cliffs, its organic design is directly inspired by the breathtaking environment and the adjacent sea.

name: Coastal Investment Villas
summary: Situated in AIDA, an exclusive gated community and renowned golfing destination, perched 130 meters above the pristine shores, these villas represent an unparalleled investment opportunity. Positioned so close to the sea that you can feel the refreshing ocean breeze, the Coastal Investment Villas offer an exceptional blend of modern design and timeless craftsmanship.

summary:
Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel investment at AIDA, Muscat,
where buyers own a freehold room and earn passive income managed by Trump Hotels.
The hotel sits 130 metres above sea level, 25 minutes from the airport, within a
master-planned destination including a championship golf course, members-only
club, SHFT NIGHT CLUB, and AIDA Beach. Rooms range from 43 to 138 sqm.

name: Trump Golf Villas
summary: Trump Golf Villas is an exclusive collection of five-bedroom luxury villas positioned along the Trump International Championship Golf Course at AIDA, Muscat, Oman, developed by DarGlobal. Set 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera with open golf and sea views, each villa from 4,367 sqft comes with a branded golf cart for effortless access across the estate.

name: Neptune Interiors by Mouawad
summary: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad is an exclusive collection of branded five-bedroom villas in the north of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, developed by DarGlobal. Mouawad, the Swiss-Lebanese jewellery house known for record-setting gemstones and artisanal craftsmanship, provided the interior design throughout each villa, ranging from 300 to 420 sqm built-up area. Located near the Expo 2030 site.

name: Tierra Viva
summary: Tierra Viva is an ultra-luxury, gated villa community in the hills of Benahavís, Costa Del Sol, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. A limited collection of villas ranging from 700 to 1,450 sqm sits tiered across the hillside, each positioned for panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea. Located 15 minutes from Marbella and minutes from Puerto Banús and 12 golf clubs.
amenities: The Pianite Villas with car Lift

name: DG1
summary: An exclusive capsule collection of luxury residences made for people who see what others don’t, do what others only dream of, and craft their futures on their own terms. The architecture of DG1 fully reflects its dynamic attitude. Like a haute couture creation, its distinctive twisting profile opens the doors of imagination, inspiring each of us in a different way.

name: Marea-Interiors by Missoni
summary:
Marea, Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive gated residential community within
the Finca Cortesin estate, Cortesin, Costa Del Sol, developed by DarGlobal.
The collection offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from
223 to 553 sqm, with Missoni-designed interiors and a 270-degree panorama
spanning from Marbella to Gibraltar and the mountains of Morocco. Phase 1 was
delivered in 2024.

name: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin
summary: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, by DarGlobal. Residences range from one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom beach villas, spanning 61 to 265 sqm, with Aston Martin-designed interiors and direct access to the beach on the water's edge.

name: Da Vinci Tower interiors by Pagani
summary:

Its striking façade, balanced on a one-of-a-kind geometric structure, creates a dynamic visual effect that commands attention. At its heart lies the pearl—a suspended sphere that adds a touch of wonder to this masterpiece.

name: Urban Oasis
summary: Urban Oasis by Missoni is a completed branded residential tower on the Dubai Canal, developed by DarGlobal with Missoni-designed interiors. The tower offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and penthouses accessed by private elevators, each with sweeping 360-degree views of the canal and the Dubai skyline. Located directly on the canal with Downtown Dubai 5 minutes away, the project is now sold out and fully completed.

Enjoy exclusive access to world-class golf courses, premium leisure facilities, and a location that keeps you connected to the city's finest attractions.
